description: Events in the order they happened, with year, description and the passages they are told in: for a period ("the exile"), a span of years, or events that mention a person or place. Called with no arguments, it lists the periods with their years. Years before Christ are negative. The world timeline gives what happened in the world around at the same time.

from_year.description: First year to include; negative is BC, e.g. -1000 for 1000 BC. Default: no lower limit.

language.description: Language for names, notes and study content, and for the links to bible.flogvit.com: en (English), nb (Norwegian Bokmål), nn (Norwegian Nynorsk), sv (Swedish), fr (French), es (Spanish), fi (Finnish), de (German). Content missing in a language falls back to English. Default: en.

mapping.description: Verse numbering to give the verse references in: a mapping id from list_verse_mappings, e.g. "english_kj" (King James) or "dnb2024_nb", or a short name such as "kjv". Default: osnb, the site's own numbering.

period.description: A period, by id or by words from its name, e.g. "exodus", "exile", "Jesus' life", "early church". Call with no arguments to see them all. Default: none.

query.description: Words the event's title or description must contain, e.g. a person ("David", "Paul") or a place ("Babylon"). Default: none.

timeline.description: bible (the events the Bible tells) or world (world history in the same periods). Default: bible.

to_year.description: Last year to include; negative is BC, e.g. -900. Default: no upper limit.

name: get_timeline
title: The Bible timeline
